meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 当你要求做发布前审查时，Claude 会先检测自上次 npm 发布以来的更改，再启动最多 10 个逐项分析代理、5 个整体审查代理和 1 个综合评估代理，最后给出含版本号建议、破坏性变更、部署风险和 changelog 草稿的审查报告。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求做发布前审查时触发，例如说“pre-publish review”“review before publish”“release review”等；单纯的发布请求不会触发。

say.text: 帮我对项目做 pre-publish review。
say.note: Claude 会检测未发布更改并启动 16 个代理审查。

say.text: 发布前审查一下，现在能发布到 npm 吗？
say.note: 这会进入审查流程，不会直接发布。

say.text: 我要发 npm 包，先跑 release review。
say.note: 必须明确说审查，否则 Claude 会直接发布。

howto.what_en: For pre-publish review, Claude finds changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 per-change agents, 5 holistic reviewers, and 1 oracle, then gives a report with version bump, breaking changes, risk, changelog.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review'). A plain publish/release request must NOT trigger it.

say_en.text: Do a pre-publish review on the current project.
Run a pre-publish check — is it safe to publish to npm?
say_en.note: This enters the review flow, not direct publish.

say_en.text: Before I publish, do a release review.
say_en.note: Say 'review' explicitly; plain publish won't trigger it.
